versions.changelog:
Initial release of general-purpose PDF processing skill.

- Supports reading, extracting text/tables, merging, splitting, rotating, watermarking, creating, encrypting/decrypting, and adding OCR to PDFs.
- Provides code examples using Python libraries (pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab).
- Includes command-line tool usage for PDF tasks (pdftotext, qpdf, pdftk, pdfimages).
- Contains guidance for extracting images, handling scanned PDFs, and working with PDF forms.
- Quick reference table included for common PDF operations.
